limitations: Investigations are scripted; the run measures the application around the model, not any model's judgment. Token counts and investigation latency are therefore not meaningful.
A scripted reviewer accepts every proposal and approves every action as shown, so the run measures what the system recommends and executes when nobody overrides it.
Waits end at their deadline on a virtual clock. Temporal timers, signals and recovery are covered by the workflow tests, not by this run.
Policy search uses a deterministic keyword retriever over PostgreSQL, not the production dense retriever.
I wrote the worlds, the labels and the scripts; this checks behavior, it is not an independent benchmark.
